name: Cablevisión Holding S.A.
summary: Cablevisión Holding S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development of infrastructure and the provision of convergent telecommunications services primarily in Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay. The company engages in the provision of fixed and mobile connectivity, and voice and data services, for individuals, homes, and companies. The company offers voice communications, mobile internet content and download content, access applications, MMS, SMS, online streaming, corporate email, and social network access, as well as sells mobile communication devices, such as handsets and Wi-Fi modems under the Personal brand.
